mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slack condition (UNRATE > 7.5%) indicates weak job market dynamics that precede corporate earnings deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdowns that precede earnings revisions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that supports corporate hiring and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation rate above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5%) signals potential monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates severe demand contraction that triggers recession fears, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals the end of emergency monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances during post-shock recovery when FEDFUNDS is stable or rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
